Doctor Jeffrey Gerdes is a chiropractor at Carolina Chirocare and Rehab in Raleigh, NC. If you are struggling with neck or back pain, headaches or migraines, carpal tunnel, sciatica, or any other health condition please call us today or visit our website and take advantage of our new patient special.

Carolina ChiroCare and Rehab
1207 Ridge Rd.
Raleigh NC 27607
https://www.carolinachirocare.com/
Call us today for a complimentary consultation: (919) 351-8368

📍 Check us out on Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15333575681526362364

Here are a few of our reviews:

Raleigh chiropractors focused on providing excellent chiropractic care with friendly, prompt service and a tailored plan for each patient. We accept most insurance and offer online scheduling and 24/7 after-hours response.
